sanskrit: sahasrapṛṣṭhaḥ śatadhāro akṣito brahmaudano devayānaḥ svargaḥ | amūṃs ta ā dadhāmi prajayā reṣaya- -enaṃ balihārāya mṛḍatāṃ mahyam eva ||
english: The brahma-odana — thousand-backed, hundred-streamed, imperishable — is the celestial path to the gods. I assign these beings to you with offspring; harass him not — let him be gratified as the bearer of tribute; be gracious to me alone.

sanskrit: ud ehi vediṃ prajayā vardhayainaṃ nudasva rakṣaḥ prataraṃ dhehy enam | śriyā samānān ati sarvānt syāma- -adhaspadaṃ dviṣataḥ pādayema ||
english: Rise up, O vedi; augment him with offspring; drive away the rakṣas; set him ever forward on the path. May we surpass in glory all who are our equals; may we make those who hate us fall beneath our feet.

sanskrit: ṛtena taṣṭā manasā hiteyaṃ brahmaudanasya nihitā vedir agre | aṃśadhrīṃ śuddhām upa dhehi nāri tatraudanaṃ sādaya daivānām ||
english: This altar, fashioned by cosmic order, established by the mind, is set before the brahma-odana. O woman, place upon it the pure portioning-ladle; settle there the odana belonging to the gods.

sanskrit: aditer hastāṃ srucam etāṃ dvitīyāṃ saptarṣayo bhūtakṛto yām akṛṇvan | sā gātrāṇi viduṣy odanasya darvir vedyām adhy enaṃ cinotu ||
english: This second ladle, born of Aditi's hand, which the seven seers — the makers of what has come into being — fashioned: may it, the ritual spoon that knows the limbs of the odana, gather him upon the altar.

sanskrit: śṛtaṃ tvā havir upa sīdantu daivā nisṛpyāgne punar enaṃ pra sīda somena pūto jaṭhare sīda brahmaṇām ārṣeyās te mā riṣan prāśitāraḥ ||
english: May the divine beings take their seat beside you, O cooked oblation; gliding forth, O Agni, settle upon him once more; purified by Soma, abide in the belly. May those descended from the seers among the brāhmaṇas who partake of you suffer no harm.

sanskrit: soma rājan saṃjñānam ā vapaibhyaḥ subrāhmaṇā yatame tvopasīdān | ṛṣīn ārṣeyāṃs tapaso 'dhi jātān brahmaudane suhavā johavīmi ||
english: O King Soma, bestow full recognition upon those noble brāhmaṇas, whoever they be, that sit in attendance upon you. The seers and their descendants born from fervent austerity — I invoke them again and again with good invocation into the brahma-odana.

sanskrit: imā āpo madhumatīr ghṛtaścyuto brahmaṇāṃ hasteṣu pra pṛthak sādayāmi | yatkāma idam abhiṣiñcāmi vo 'ham indro marutvāṃs tad adād idaṃ me ||
english: These honey-sweet, ghee-dripping waters I separately settle in the hands of the brāhmaṇas. With whatever wish I sprinkle you, may Indra, accompanied by the Maruts, have granted that very thing to me.

sanskrit: idaṃ me jyotir amṛtaṃ hiraṇyaṃ pakvaṃ kṣetrāt kāmadughā ma eṣā | idaṃ dhanaṃ ni dadhe brāhmaṇeṣu kṛṇve panthāṃ pitṛṣu yaḥ svargaḥ ||
english: This is my light, immortal and golden; cooked from the field, she is a wish-yielding cow for me. This wealth I deposit among the brāhmaṇas; I open the path among the ancestors that leads to heaven.

sanskrit: agnau tuṣām̐ ā vapa jātavedasi paraḥ kambūkān upa mṛḍhy etān | etaṃ śuśruma gṛharājasya bhāgam atho vidma nirṛter bhāgadheyam ||
english: Scatter the husks into Agni Jātavedas; beyond them, be gracious to these kuṭaja worms. This share, we have heard, belongs to the lord of the house; and we know the portion that belongs to Nirṛti.

sanskrit: śrāmyataḥ pacata edhi sunvataḥ svargaṃ lokam adhi rohayainam | yena rohāt param āpadya yad vayaḥ ||
english: Be cooked, O toiling one; arise, O pressing one; cause him to ascend the heavenly realm, that by which he may attain the highest, whatever vitality he has.

sanskrit: babhrer adhvaryo mukham etad vi mṛḍḍhy ājyāya lokaṃ kṛṇuhi prajānan | ghṛtena gātrānu sarvā vi mṛḍḍhi kṛṇve panthāṃ pitṛṣu yaḥ svargaḥ ||
english: O adhvaryu, anoint this face of the brown one; knowing it, make way for the ghee; anoint all its limbs with ghee. I open the path among the ancestors that leads to heaven.

sanskrit: babhre rakṣaḥ samadam ā vapaibhyo brāhmaṇā yatame tvopasīdān | purīṣiṇaḥ prathamānāḥ purastād ārṣeyās te mā riṣan prāśitāraḥ ||
english: O brown one, scatter the demon of equal fury away from those brāhmaṇas, whoever sit in attendance upon you. Those who are first and foremost, filled with sacredness — may those descended from the seers who partake of you suffer no harm.

sanskrit: ārṣeyeṣu ni dadha odana tvā nānārṣeyāṇām apy asty atra | agnir me goptā marutaś ca sarve viśve devā abhi rakṣantu pakvam ||
english: I place you, O odana, among those descended from the seers; here too there is a place for those not of diverse ṛṣi lineage. May Agni be my protector, and all the Maruts, and all the Viśve Devās guard what has been cooked.

sanskrit: yajñaṃ duhānaṃ sadam it prapīnaṃ pumāṃsaṃ dhenuṃ sadanaṃ rayīṇām | prajāmṛtatvam uta dīrgham āyū rāyaś ca poṣam upa tvā sadema ||
english: Ever yielding the sacrifice, always well-nourished, a virile cow, a seat of riches — may we be seated near you for immortality through offspring, for long life, and for the abundance of wealth.

sanskrit: vṛṣabho 'si svarga ṛṣīn ārṣeyān gaccha | sukṛtāṃ loke sīda tan nau saṃkṛtam ||
english: You are a bull, O heaven; go to the seers and their descendants. Settle in the world of those who have done good deeds — that is our compact.

sanskrit: sam ā cinuṣvānusaṃprehy agne pathaḥ kalpaya devayānān | ebhiḥ sukṛtair anu pra jñeṣma yajñe nāke tiṣṭhantam adhi saptaraśmau ||
english: Heap it together, follow along behind, O Agni; make ready the paths that lead to the gods. By means of these good deeds may we come to know him who stands at the sacrifice, on the vault of heaven, upon the seven rays.

sanskrit: yena devā jyotiṣā dyām udāyan brahmaudanaṃ paktvā sukṛtasya lokam | taṃ tvā pacāmi jyotiṣāṃ jyotir uttamaṃ sa nas taṃ dhehi sukṛtām uloke ||
english: By that light with which the gods ascended the sky — having cooked the brahma-odana, the world of the well-doer — that very light, the highest of lights, I cook you; grant us that light in the world of those who have done well.

sanskrit: prācyai tvā diśe nir vapāmi śatadhāram apakṣudham | sa paktāraṃ vaha sukṛtāṃ yatra loko yatra ṛṣayaḥ prathamajāḥ purāṇāḥ ||
english: Toward the eastern quarter I scatter you, hundred-streamed, free from hunger. Carry the one who has cooked you to the world of the well-doers, where the primordially born seers of old dwell.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇāyai tvā (…) ||
english: Toward the southern quarter — [as above].

sanskrit: pratīcyai tvā (…) ||
english: Toward the western quarter — [as above].

sanskrit: udīcyai tvā (…) ||
english: Toward the northern quarter — [as above].

sanskrit: dhruvāyai tvā (…) ||
english: Toward the fixed quarter — [as above].

sanskrit: ūrdhvāyai tvā (…) ||
english: Toward the upward quarter — [as above].

sanskrit: dive tvā (…) ||
english: To heaven — [as above].

sanskrit: antarikṣāya tvā (…) ||
english: To the atmosphere — [as above].

sanskrit: pṛthivyai tvā (…) ||
english: To the earth — [as above].

sanskrit: paśubhyas tvā (…) ||
english: To the cattle — [as above].
